tools.name: upload_supplier_feed
tools.description: Upload explicitly supplied UTF-8 CSV or JSONL (10 MiB, 50,000 records maximum). Stores it for 24 hours. No URL or local file paths.
tools.prerequisites: Explicit permission to read the source; remote upload also needs permission to transmit it
tools.outputs: Upload identity/fingerprint or bounded inferred schema
tools.retry: Uploads create new identities; reuse the successful upload rather than uploading again

tools.name: preview_supplier_feed
tools.description: Propose field mappings for an uploaded flat feed. Preview is not full validation or semantic approval.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: create_supplier_feed_profile
tools.description: Save an unapproved versioned profile with explicit mapping, decimal locale, and quality rules.
tools.prerequisites: Owned source plus explicit target rules/decisions
tools.outputs: Unapproved proposal, version or sampled preview; not approval or full validation
tools.approval: Do not infer business meanings; obtain missing decisions
tools.retry: Reads/previews may repeat; saved drafts/versions can create new identities

tools.name: list_supplier_feed_profiles
tools.description: List owned saved profile identities in pages of 50. Read a specific profile before reusing or approving it.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: get_supplier_feed_profile
tools.description: Read an owned profile's exact destination schema, approved decisions, contract, and version identity.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: delete_supplier_feed_profile
tools.description: Permanently delete an owned saved profile after explicit operator instruction. This does not start an evaluation or use credits.
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Deletion status; dependent pending jobs can fail safely
tools.retry: Read current state before retry; do not delete another version

tools.name: approve_supplier_feed_profile
tools.description: Persist an explicit approval of the exact profile after the operator has resolved its field meanings and rules.
tools.prerequisites: Exact reviewed hash/fingerprint and scope, with all unresolved choices settled
tools.outputs: Approval bound to that exact version
tools.approval: Explicit authorized reviewer approval; fixture permission covers only owned fixtures
tools.retry: Reuse only the same reviewed version and scope; edits invalidate approval

tools.name: quote_supplier_import
tools.description: Quote one full-file evaluation against an approved profile. Detects source drift. Does not charge or start work.
tools.prerequisites: Owned upload and approved matching supplier profile
tools.outputs: Quote, expiry, exact fingerprints and funding; drift can return review_required
tools.approval: Approval required before quoting; quote does not start work
tools.retry: Reuse the original quote/key for an uncertain started request; only quote anew for genuinely new work

tools.name: start_supplier_import
tools.description: Start the quoted evaluation using one funded credit under the account cap. A completed rejection report is billable; platform failures release the credit.
tools.prerequisites: Unexpired funded quote and stable idempotency key
tools.credits: Reserves one evaluation; completed passed or rejected jobs consume one; review_required stops before start without consuming an evaluation; platform failures release the reservation
tools.retry: Original quote AND original key; changed requests need a new quote/key; never start twice after a timeout

tools.name: get_supplier_import
tools.description: Read an owned job's status and receipt. Does not initiate or repeat evaluation.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: get_supplier_import_report
tools.description: Read the complete-file validation report for an owned completed job during its seven-day result retention.
tools.task: Read an owned result or decision
tools.prerequisites: Existing owned resource and current account authorization
tools.outputs: Structured result; inspect disclosed coverage and errors
tools.approval: Read access within the user's task
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity

tools.name: get_supplier_import_output
tools.description: Read validated JSONL in pages of up to 500 records / 64 KiB for an owned passed job within seven days. Follow next_offset. Oversized records require an authenticated download of download_path.
tools.prerequisites: Passed owned job within seven-day output retention
tools.outputs: Paged validated records; follow pagination to completion
tools.retry: Read again using the same resource identity
